title: STAIR TAX
subtitle: MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS. OFFICE SCALE. TAX THE LEGS. KEEP THE BREATH HONEST.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. MONDAY. STAIR TAX. FIFTEEN MINUTES. LEGS AND LUNGS. WE TAX THE LEGS. WE KEEP THE BREATH HONEST. NO HIDING BEHIND THE DESK.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. STAIR TAX PAID. LEGS WORKED. LUNGS HONEST. SEE YOU TOMORROW.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: CHAIR SIT-TO-STAND
exercises.cue: STURDY CHAIR BEHIND YOU. LIGHT TOUCH THEN STAND. CHEST UP. KNEES TRACK THE TOES. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS.
exercises.speakStart: CHAIR SIT-TO-STAND. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. LIGHT TOUCH ON THE SEAT. STAND CLEAN. CHEST UP. LEGS FIRST. NO PLONKING, YOU LAZY SOD.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE LEGS. DO NOT SIT FOR REAL.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS
exercises.cue: STAIR OR STURDY STEP. DRIVE THROUGH THE WHOLE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. LIGHT HAND ON A WALL IF YOU WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP. STAND TALL. WALL FOR BALANCE IF YOU NEED IT. THIS IS LEGS AND LUNGS. OWN THE WOBBLE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. STEADY THE BREATH. STAY OFF THE RAILING FOR A NAP.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. TOUCH THE CHAIR FOR BALANCE. OWN THE WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. CONTROL THE DROP. CHAIR FOR BALANCE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TIP OVER LIKE A DRUNK ON PARADE.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS ON A STURDY CHAIR OR FLOOR. EASY MARCHING PACE. HIPS LEVEL. BREATHE OUT ON EACH KNEE DRIVE. NO SPRINT.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO SETS. TWENTY SECONDS. EASY MARCHING PACE. HANDS ON THE CHAIR IF THE FLOOR IS TOO MUCH. THIS IS THE LUNGS TAX. DO NOT SPRINT AND DIE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. CATCH YOUR BREATH. DO NOT DRAMATISE.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: LOW BACK FLAT ON THE FLOOR. SLOW OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. POSTURE DRILL. NO RUSH.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. BACK FLAT. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR POSTURE DRILL. FIX THE DESK HUNCH. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE BACK QUIET.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUG COMPLETE. THAT IS THE LOT.
